fact: The District Council of Grand Port named the public places in the first schedule of its Naming of public places Regulations 2025, made 26 November 2025 and gazetted 18 April 2026 (GN No. 45 of 2026).
title: District Council of Grand Port (Naming of public places) Regulations 2025
publisher: Government Gazette of Mauritius No. 27 of 18 April 2026 (District Council of Grand Port)
